prompt: Continue the actual Relay implementation with one bounded evidence improvement. Extend RelayResult and RelayLifecycle so each static/mock lifecycle result carries deterministic dispatch evidence: the envelope packet SHA-256, the session_id when one was created, and a prompt/dispatch attempt count that is 0 when no transport prompt was invoked (STOP, duplicate/conflict, pre-prompt block) and exactly 1 when one prompt invocation was attempted, including the TimeoutError path. Do not infer delivery/completion from the attempt count. Preserve simulated/live separation, retry=0, no fallback, timeout cancel+close, and sticky stop behavior. Keep backward compatibility where practical with defaults on new RelayResult fields. Add regression tests for at least normal simulated dispatch, timeout, and stop/duplicate no-prompt paths. Do not add live provider execution. Run relevant relay tests, then PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v, python -m compileall -q src tests, and git diff --check.
